title: Setting Phone Limits for Focus
paragraphs: Menyadari bahwa ia menghabiskan hampir tiga jam sehari menggulir ponselnya tanpa disadari, Ilham memutuskan untuk mengatur batas waktu harian pada aplikasi yang paling sering ia gunakan agar bisa lebih fokus kembali.
Beberapa hari pertama terasa tidak nyaman, karena ia terus meraih ponselnya karena kebiasaan, hanya untuk diingatkan oleh notifikasi bahwa waktu yang dialokasikan untuk aplikasi itu sudah habis.
Menjelang minggu kedua, ia menyadari memiliki lebih banyak waktu luang di malam hari, yang ia gunakan untuk membaca buku yang sudah lama ingin ia selesaikan tanpa berhasil selama beberapa bulan.
Ilham memberi tahu adiknya bahwa batasan itu awalnya terasa membatasi, tapi sebenarnya mengembalikan jam-jam dari harinya yang diam-diam menghilang tanpa ia sadari sama sekali.
answerKey: Noticing that he spends nearly three hours a day scrolling through his phone without realizing it, Ilham decides to set a daily time limit on his most-used apps to regain some focus. The first few days feel uncomfortable, since he keeps reaching for his phone out of habit, only to be reminded by a notification that his allotted time for that app has already ended. By the second week, he notices he has more free time in the evenings, which he uses to read a book he had been meaning to finish for several months without success. Ilham tells his brother that the limit felt restrictive at first, but it actually gave him back hours of his day that had quietly been disappearing without him noticing at all.
